formulas.formula: Plan your whole year, log every purchase, and watch every tab fill itself in.
Fills in from the year above (this year if blank).
To change it, select the money cells and use Format > Number.
1. In YOUR SETUP, type your budget year. Every tab follows it.
2. Open Budget Plan. Rename the categories to fit your life (use the blank rows for more).
3. On Budget Plan, type a Monthly Amount for each category. It fills January to December for you.
4. A month is different (a bonus, holiday gifts)? Type over that month's amount on Budget Plan.
5. Aim for 'Left to Plan' = $0 at the bottom of Budget Plan, so every dollar has a job.
6. Log every paycheck and purchase on Transactions: date, category (pick from the list) and amount.
7. That's it! The 12 month tabs, Year Summary and the Dashboard fill themselves in.
8. Tick off bills on Bills, and list what you pay for on Subscriptions.
9. Once a month, update Savings Goals, Debt Payoff (current balance) and Net Worth.
10. Got a refund? Log it as a negative amount in the same category.
11. The example numbers show a whole year. To start fresh, go to Transactions, select columns A to F
from row 2 down and press Delete (don't delete the rows). Then type over the other examples.
Your year at a glance: totals, savings rate, charts, top categories and highlights.
Your categories and how much you plan for each one, every month of the year.
One list for every paycheck and purchase. Everything else reads from here.
One tab per month, filled in for you: budget vs. actual for every category, with a chart.
Every category, every month, side by side, with totals and monthly averages.
A checklist of your bills with due days. Tick a box when a bill is paid.
Everything you pay for regularly, what it costs per year, and what to cancel.
Goals with progress bars, fed by your savings transactions.
Your debts, how much you paid down, interest paid and months left.
What you own minus what you owe, month by month, with a chart.
White cells: type your numbers here.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you. No typing needed.
Red: something to check (over budget, a missing category, text in a number cell).
Green: on track or better than planned.
Log purchases as they happen, or set a 10-minute money date once a week.
Plan for yearly costs (gifts, insurance, memberships) with a small amount every month.
Pay yourself first: move money to savings on payday, before you spend.
Over budget in a category? Move money from another category instead of giving up.
Check the Dashboard at the end of each month and adjust next month's plan.
Buy with a credit card? Log each purchase in its category. Under Debt, log only what you pay toward an old balance, so nothing counts twice.
Thank you for your purchase! Here's to your best money year yet.
Everything here updates from your Transactions tab.
Tip: if something looks off, check 'Transactions to fix' above and the Check column on Transactions.
Type a Monthly Amount and it fills every month. Different in one month? Type over that month (it turns blue). Rename categories, but don't insert or delete rows.
Red category name: it's listed twice, has amounts but no name, or uses * ? ~ or starts with < > = (rename it).
Left to Plan: green = every dollar has a job, yellow = money not planned yet, red = planned more than you earn.

=IF(AND(A{row}="",B{row}="",D{row}=""),"",IF(OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(A{row})),N(A{row})<1,N(A{row})>2958465),"Check the date",IF(YEAR(A{row})<>'Start Here'!$D$8,"Not in "&'Start Here'!$D$8,IF(B{row}="","Pick a category",IF(G{row}="Not found","Category not on Budget Plan",IF(D{row}="","Add an amount",IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(D{row})),"Amount must be a number","OK")))))))
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!D66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!D66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for January: New year, fresh start: set your Budget Plan for the whole year, then log every purchase as it happens.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!E66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!E66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for February: Look at January: which categories went over? Adjust February's plan to match real life.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!F66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!F66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for March: Look for yearly charges hiding in your statements, like memberships that renew once a year.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!G66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!G66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for April: Tax refund? Give it a job before it arrives: emergency fund, debt, or a savings goal.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!H66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!H66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for May: Do a subscription check on the Subscriptions tab. Cancel anything you haven't used in a month.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!I66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!I66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for June: Halfway there! Open the Dashboard and compare your first six months to your plan.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!J66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!J66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for July: Vacation month? Pay for trips from your Vacation Fund, not your credit card.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!K66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!K66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for August: Back-to-school and fall costs are coming. Plan them now so they don't surprise you.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!L66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!L66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for September: Start your holiday fund if you haven't yet. A little each month makes December easy.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!M66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!M66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for October: Review insurance and phone plans. Switching or asking for a discount saves money all year.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!N66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!N66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for November: Make a gift list with a price for each person, and stick to your Gifts budget.
=IF(ROUND('Year Summary'!O66,2)<>0,"Heads up: "&TEXT('Year Summary'!O66,"$#,##0.00")&" this month isn't in a category yet. See the Check column on Transactions.","")
Tip for December: Celebrate your wins! Read your Year Summary, then make a copy of this file for next year.
Filled in automatically from Transactions. Nothing to type here. Budget So Far = your plan for the months that have transactions.
Total of the bills on this list
Tick the box under the month when a bill is paid. Paid boxes turn green.
Bills on autopay still need a check: make sure the money is there before the due day.
Log the payment on Transactions too, so it counts in your budget.
Cancel the ones marked Cancel and you save per year:
Billing: pick Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly or Yearly. Monthly and Yearly Cost fill in.
Renews On: the next date you'll be charged. Set a reminder a few days before.
Budget the monthly total under Subscriptions on Budget Plan, and log each charge on Transactions.
Pick a goal from your Savings categories (or type your own), then add the Target and what you had saved on January 1 (Starting Balance).
Added This Year fills in from Transactions: every transfer you log to that category counts.
Monthly Plan comes from Budget Plan (the category's year total divided by 12).
Tip: build a starter emergency fund of $1,000 first, then grow it to 3-6 months of expenses.
Pick a debt from your Debt categories, then type the balance on January 1, the interest rate (22.99 or 22.99%) and, once a month, the Current Balance from your statement.
Paid This Year fills in from Transactions. Interest & Charges = what you paid minus how much the balance went down (interest, fees and any new purchases). Keep Current Balance up to date.
Monthly Payment comes from Budget Plan. Months Left assumes you keep paying that amount.
Snowball: pay extra on Payoff Order 1 (the smallest balance) first. When it's gone, roll its payment into the next one.
'Payment too low' means the payment doesn't cover the monthly interest yet. A rate under 1%? Type it with the % sign, like 0.9%.

formula: OR($K2="Payment too low",$K2="Add it to Budget Plan",$K2="Fix a payment")

formulas.formula: Once a month, type what you own (assets) and what you owe (debts). Net worth = assets - debts.
Don't worry if it's negative at first (student loans do that). Watch the line go up.
